_meta.com.requstory/summary: Send a buyer's quote request to a supplier in the Index; the supplier replies by email.

annotations.title: Request a quote from a supplier

description: Send a quote request to one supplier from search_suppliers on behalf of a buyer: what they need, how many and where to deliver. The supplier gets it by email and replies to the buyer directly; nothing is ordered or paid. Use only with the buyer's consent to share their name and email with that supplier. Returns status "sent", or "waiting" when the supplier has no address for requests yet (Requstory passes it on).

buyerEmail.description: The buyer's email, where the supplier replies. Use it only with the buyer's consent.

deliverTo.description: Where to deliver: town or postcode and country.

items.description: What the buyer needs: products, sizes, specifications.

message.description: Anything else for the supplier, such as a delivery date.

quantity.description: How many, e.g. "5,000 cups a month".

supplier.description: The "supplier" value from search_suppliers (the supplier's website domain).

name: request_quote
